claims.statement: check-agents-structure.sh is the portable validator that accepts a single target argument defaulting to .agents, normalizes it via ${target%/}, and scopes all checks strictly to that tree to allow validating example/.agents or any copied knowledge layer.

The portable validator asserts a fixed required-files manifest with -f checks for AGENTS.md, .gitignore, playbooks/README.md, sessions/README.md, skills/aksk-bootstrap, docs-lint, learning-distill, task-closeout SKILL.md files plus the task-closeout example bundle files (summary.json, active-task.md, learning-candidate.md, changed-files.txt, validation.txt); missing entries increment failures.

Session tracking is git-aware: inside a git worktree it compares git ls-files -- target/sessions sorted against the single expected file target/sessions/README.md via exact string equality and reports ignored bundles via git status --short --ignored; outside git it warns and skips tracked/ignored checks, enforcing that only README.md is tracked.

Skill frontmatter validation finds target/skills/**/SKILL.md and checks line 1 is --- and that first 12 lines contain ^name: and ^description:; JSON enumeration uses git ls-files or find with prune on sessions/[0-9]* and validates with jq empty when jq is on PATH otherwise warns and skips.

check-publish.sh is the starter-repo release wrapper that cds to git rev-parse --show-toplevel (or pwd) and delegates to check-agents-structure.sh on root .agents only, then adds starter-repo-only hygiene sections and exits 1 when failures>0 (warnings never block).

Markdown formatting section in check-publish.sh probes remark via npx --no-install remark --frail with .remarkrc.json (remark-frontmatter + remark-gfm) bounded by timeout 60s; it fails on violations and warns/skips when npx/remark unavailable.

Markdown link section runs npx --no-install markdown-link-check --alive 200,0 per tracked *.md excluding example/* bounded by timeout 30s per file; --alive 200,0 keeps offline/CSP status 0 from failing every external URL; any file failure increments failures.

Publish leakage scans use rg --hidden --glob '!*sessions/[0-9]*' for high-signal secrets (Bearer, sk-, ghp_, github_pat_, AWS_*, BEGIN PRIVATE KEY, /home/, C:\Users\) over README.md INSTALL.md docs .agents as warning-only, while the doubled-path hygiene scan for \.agents/\.agents/ over the same paths is a hard fail indicating a bad global replace.

package.json wires npm run check to bash scripts/check-publish.sh and format to remark over .agents/**/*.md, with devDependencies markdown-link-check, remark-cli, remark-frontmatter, remark-gfm, and skills; jq and rg are system CLIs (apt/brew/choco) not npm dependencies.

Pre-publish playbook (.agents/playbooks/pre-publish.md) sequences check-publish.sh as blocking, requires only sessions/README.md tracked, review of find .agents -maxdepth 4 file list, separation of portable kit contract vs maintainer-only dogfood, sync_wiki_indexes.mjs after wiki edits, docs-lint before publish, and git status/diff before tagging; leakage hits are intentionally narrow and never auto-fail.

generate-example is maintainer-only (internal: true) not distributed to consumers with canonical reference .agents/playbooks/generate-example.md; run.sh from repo root removes and recreates example/, runs npx skills add <repo_root> -y --copy --agent cursor for user-facing skills only, simulates learning-distill init by copying bootstrap templates into example/.agents (playbooks/README.md, sessions/README.md, AGENTS.md when missing) and writes example/.agents/.gitignore with sessions/* and !sessions/README.md.

The regeneration invariant requires regenerating example/ whenever the portable kit or bootstrap templates change and verifying wiring blocks and structure (check-agents-structure.sh on example/.agents and docs-lint) before publish; example/ must remain disposable and must not be populated by copying the full dogfood .agents tree or curated wiki content.

Major-version-release playbook requires three checks for a major release: aggressively grep the entire repo for deprecated artifact names (e.g., docs-search-index.json), review platform portability of new Python/bash scripts for cross-platform paths, and regenerate example/ via the generator playbook and ensure kit layout health.

Operational invariants: all npx probes use --no-install gated by timeout (15s availability, 60s remark, 30s per link file) and never install; missing jq/npx/rg degrades to WARN not false pass/fail; portability requires only bash/sed/grep/find plus git for session tracking; failures block publish while warnings require manual review.
